passive.name: Unseen Threat
passive.text: Nearby enemies that are Isolated from their allies are marked. Kha'Zix's abilities have interactions with Isolated targets.When Kha'Zix is not visible to the enemy team, he gains Unseen Threat, causing his next basic attack against an enemy champion to deal bonus magic damage and slow them for a few seconds.

spells.name: Taste Their Fear
spells.text: Deals physical damage to the target. Damage increased on Isolated targets. If he chooses to Evolve Reaper Claws, this refunds a percent of it's cooldown against Isolated targets. Kha'Zix also gains increased range on his basic attacks and Taste Their Fear.

spells.name: Void Spike
spells.text: Kha'Zix fires exploding spikes that deal physical damage to enemies hit. Kha'Zix is healed if he is also within the explosion radius. If he chooses to Evolve Spike Racks, Void Spike now fires three spikes in a cone, slow enemies hit, and reveals enemy champions hit for 2 seconds. Isolated targets are slowed for extra.

spells.name: Leap
spells.text: Kha'Zix leaps to an area, dealing physical damage upon landing. If he chooses to Evolve Wings, Leap's range increases by 200 and the cooldown resets on champion kill or assist.

spells.name: Void Assault
spells.text: Each rank allows Kha'Zix to evolve one of his abilities, giving it a unique additional effect. When activated, Kha'Zix becomes Invisible, triggering Unseen Threat and increasing Move Speed. If he chooses to Evolve Adaptive Cloaking, Void Assault gains increased Invisibility duration, and an additional use.

damage.value: Kha'Zix deals physical damage with Q, W, and E, then adds a burst of magic damage with Unseen Threat.

archetype.value: Kha'Zix plays as an assassin, securing quick kills and escaping fights.

axis.value: Kha'Zix can take longer trades when Q evolution increases his DPS.

winCondition.value: Kha'Zix dominates the map by securing quick kills and escaping fights.

spikes.why: Kha'Zix gets a shorter Q cooldown early, increasing his DPS in longer trades.
Kha'Zix gains map pressure and survivability in teamfights.
Kha'Zix can evolve one ability for an additional effect.

bait.why: Kha'Zix cannot Leap again until its cooldown ends unless evolved E resets on a champion kill or assist.

mistakes.value: Kha'Zix gives up Q’s increased damage by using it on a target that is not Isolated.
